reading: Miss on the frozen rule: the three-year mean, 117 permits a year, is below the low of 139. 2023 (247) was inside the range at 0.63 times the middle; 2024 (93) and 2025 (10) were below it. The fall coincides with Austin's 2024 changes to its residential code, so the frozen class may have stopped capturing ADUs; that has not been checked, and the score stands as frozen.
